headline.purpose: The plan decision and onboarding title.

metric.purpose: Distance, pace, score and window time; condensed tabular.

timer.purpose: Live recorder active time; the largest element on Track.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Selected segment and floating map controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action on paper surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #9b1c3c; color: #fff; font: 650 15px/1.2 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #84162f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e5fa8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Course Button
components.description: Start the outing; course ink on the ink band.
components.css: .ds-band { padding: 16px; background: #0d1724; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-btn-course { width: 100%; min-height: 54px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #ff4d7a; color: #0d1724; font: 750 16px/1.2 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: filter 180ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-course:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-course:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #eef2f5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-course:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Activity, duration, day and share layout choices.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-grid; grid-auto-flow: column; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 10px; background: #e2e7ea; } .ds-seg button { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: none; color: #3f4b58; font: 600 15px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #fdfefe; color: #0d1724; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(13 23 36 / .06), 0 2px 8px rgb(13 23 36 / .05); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e5fa8; }

components.name: Area Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #cbd3d9; border-radius: 999px; background: #fdfefe; color: #0d1724; font: 550 15px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #8d99a5; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #0d1724; border-color: #0d1724; color: #eef2f5; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e5fa8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled input with a blue focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 600 13px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #3f4b58; } .ds-field input { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd3d9; border-radius: 10px; background: #fdfefe; color: #0d1724; font: 400 16px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1e5fa8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(30 95 168 / .25); }

components.name: Dock
components.css: .ds-dock { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 4px; width: 360px; height: 64px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #0d1724; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgb(13 23 36 / .24); } .ds-dock a { display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 999px; color: #a9b6c3; font: 600 12px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dock a:hover { color: #eef2f5; } .ds-dock a[aria-current="page"] { background: #eef2f5; color: #0d1724; }

components.name: Meteogram Strip
components.description: Remaining hours as comfort-coloured bars with the bracketed window.
components.css: .ds-meteo { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 40px); align-items: end; height: 72px; padding: 8px; background: #0d1724; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-meteo span { height: var(--h); margin: 0 5px; border-radius: 3px 3px 1px 1px; background: #3dd68c; } .ds-meteo span[data-t="f"] { background: #ffb547; } .ds-meteo span[data-t="p"] { background: #ff8a3d; } .ds-meteo i { position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 6px; left: 28px; width: 80px; border: 2px solid #ff4d7a; border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; }

narrative.overview: VAELORA is read the way a good meteogram is read: one glance tells you what the next hours hold and when to go. Conditions are drawn, not described. Each remaining hour is a column whose height and colour are the scorer's comfort band, with the temperature written above it, and the recommended outing is bracketed in a single reserved ink. Everything else in the product, from the share card to the live recorder, borrows that chart's discipline: a cool paper ground, synoptic navy ink, hairline rules, condensed tabular figures.
keyCharacteristics: An ink plan band that holds the single decision and its single action.
A meteogram strip as the signature data graphic.
One variable grotesk whose width axis is the hierarchy.
Flat surfaces with hairlines; depth only for overlays and the floating dock.
Restrained motion that explains state: press, sheet rise, live pulse.

rules.name: The One Course Rule
rules.body: Course ink marks only the active outing (its window, bracket, start, live route and selected place). It never decorates.

rules.name: The Conditions Mean Conditions Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and vermilion appear only for comfort bands and GPS quality, never for brand, activity or emphasis.

rules.name: The Width Is Rank Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy for numbers comes from the width axis and weight, not from new families: condensed for metrics, normal for text, expanded only for the brand.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No tracked uppercase labels above headings; the heading speaks.

rules.name: The Float Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element floats above content. Panels in the flow use a hairline or a tonal step instead.

dos: Do keep one primary action per band, in course ink.
Do set every metric in condensed tabular Archivo and every label in the label style.
Do isolate numbers and times with bdi so they read correctly in Arabic.
Do use Western digits in both languages so times, distances and metrics read the same.
Do keep notices neutral (surface tone plus a small status dot); errors use the danger text colour.
Do keep missing values explicit ("–", "Conditions unavailable") instead of estimating.
Do keep motion to opacity, colour and short transforms under 250ms, and drop movement under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use course ink or the condition ramp for decoration, brand accents or charts that are not conditions.
Don't add eyebrow labels, section numbers or em dashes in interface copy.
Don't stack cards inside cards; use rows, rules and tonal steps.
Don't add shadows to elements that sit in the flow.
Don't invent score differences, place facts or achievements to fill space.
